originals.caption: ​安平古堡，原稱熱蘭遮城、安平城或臺灣城，是一座位於臺灣臺南市安平區的一個城郭遺址。於1624年由荷蘭東印度公司建立，是臺灣最早的要塞建築。自建城以來，曾是荷蘭人統治臺灣的中樞，也曾是鄭氏王朝統治者的住處。
originals.inspection: 2022 remnant original inspected: irregular plaster loss/brickwork, roots and gaps, nonuniform broken top; curb/planting not a building wall-height datum.

primarySources.inspection: Tainan operator distinguishes surviving old southern wall from later rebuilt site;1975 renovation added pointed roof and white exterior to the tower. Current exterior is not the complete Dutch fortress.

Owner history:1897 portions leveled and three brick platforms built;1930 residence adapted to exhibition/reception hall;1935 excavations near southwest bastion;1975 pointed-roof white tower finish. Historical fort dimensions do not specify the current ruins or current tower.

2024 heritage authority states red-topped lookout originates in1944, with red pointed roof added1975. It identifies surviving north/south walls, southwest bastion archaeology and west drainage. Current site combines different periods; do not reconstruct absent Dutch enclosure from artwork.

Actual primary text identifies outer southern wall relicNo11 as approximately65.8m east/west, with failing brick/mortar, deformed opening, vegetation and cracks. This is not a precise modern wall-axis bearing or height.
